name: app_launch
description: A soft breeze swelling and settling
use: Splash screen, first launch, app ready
prompt: A soft breeze swelling gently and ending with a single clear water drop into a pool, calm and welcoming, natural, no music, no chime

name: sign_in
use: Signed in, account created, welcome back
prompt: A small wooden door latch lifted and the door opening softly, short gentle creak and click, close up, no music

name: sign_out
prompt: A small wooden door closing gently with a soft latch click, short, close up, no music

name: payment_success
description: Two coins placed on a wooden table
use: Payment complete, sadaqah or zakat donation sent, purchase confirmed
prompt: Two small metal coins placed softly one after another onto a wooden table, short gentle clink, close up, no music, no ringing

name: timer_end
use: Timer or countdown finished, focus session over
prompt: Exactly three separate clear water drops falling one after another into a still pool, evenly spaced, close up, natural, no music, no tone, no bells
note: Variation 5 was assembled with ffmpeg from the clean drop in variation 2, repeated three times 0.38 s apart, because no single generation produced three separate drops.

name: alarm_gentle
description: A soft dawn chorus slowly rising
use: Wake-up alarms, scheduled reminders that need attention
prompt: A soft dawn chorus of a few songbirds slowly growing louder over a gentle breeze, natural and calm, no music, no voice

name: connection_lost
use: Went offline, connection lost, sync paused
prompt: A short gust of breeze quickly dying out into stillness, soft and descending, natural, no music

name: connection_restored
description: A small stream starting to flow
use: Back online, connection restored, sync resumed
prompt: A small stream starting to flow again over pebbles, quick soft rise of trickling water, natural, no music

name: low_battery
use: Low battery, storage almost full, quota almost reached
prompt: Three slow water drips from a nearly empty clay jug, each one softer and further apart, running dry, close up, natural, no music, no tone, no hum
note: High-passed at 300 Hz to remove a steady low drone under the drips.

name: screenshot
prompt: A quick soft snap of a sheet of paper being flicked taut, crisp and short, close up, dry, no music
